summary: The team is executing a global marketing strategy centered on Asia Star and Intelligent China, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving operational email issues.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the global marketing strategy sync from June 30, where we decided to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO/AI-search visibility, targeting top-five ranking for China executive programs. Joseph is drafting the SEO/AI-search visibility plan and profiling Asia Star participants and CRM hot leads, which is urgent this week. The knowledge website redesign is also in motion: we agreed to combine elements from both design versions, keep the two-menu structure, and integrate BCI/BSI indices; Joseph must share his HTML file and Joker will make changes based on feedback. Additionally, we need to resolve the Outlook account lockout by re-logging in all email accounts and updating passwords, and contact JSB to confirm backend unlock. Looking ahead, we have upcoming actions like promoting spotlight videos, tweaking MBA social posts, and sending APEC event confirmations, but these are secondary to the strategic initiatives.

Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School) at the top.
Combine elements from both design versions rather than choosing one entirely.
Bring BCI and BSI indices into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
